selection.rule: highest macro decision accuracy under leave-one-dataset-out; among systems within one standard error of the best, drop those whose out-of-fold Top-1 on svc:unseen is more than 0.02 below the best candidate's; of the rest, the least complex
selection.caveat: the maximum over many candidates is optimistic; the selection itself is computed from validation only, but the generalisation guard and the candidate list were chosen after the external set had been looked at (docs/decision-layer.md); the test split was not used
